design.brief:
A macro close up shot of @tommy with rain slowly dripping down the visor of his helmet. In the background A rain-drenched racetrack at midnight, covered in puddles on gritty asphalt reflecting the neon lights in their reflections. Overhead stadium lights pierce through a heavy downpour, reflecting off a massive puddles in the dark, dramatic night. Fog obscures details in the distance.
Rainy and dark and dramatic night time with billowing thunderhead clouds and deep blue shadows.

elements.name: Tommy
elements.look: A detailed character concept sheet for a futuristic race car driver, showcasing a high-performance racing suit crafted from matte black and crimson red leather. The central figure stands confidently in full gear including black leather boots, wearing a sleek aerodynamic helmet with a striking, highly reflective red chrome visor that completely hides their face and mirrors the dramatic track lights.

elements.name: car
elements.look: A cinematic cutting-edge open-wheel race car in side view boasting a aggressive, aerodynamic chassis clad in a striking matte black and vibrant crimson red livery. Bright overhead track lights glint off the glossy red carbon fiber panels, while deep shadow plays across the sculpted black wings.
